title: Woven Dress
subtitle: Blue / ivory diagonal stripe / open back / gathered skirt
status: PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT SPECIFICATION — SAMPLE VALIDATION REQUIRED
fit: Close upper body with 4 cm bust ease, shaped long upper section and softly gathered midi lower skirt.
market: Adult Womenswear / EU-labelled development range; no UK conversion implied

bom.specification: PROPOSED drapey stable plain weave, 130–170 g/m²; diagonal engineered print; shrinkage trial
bom.colour: Blue / ivory; lab dips and print strike-off TBD
bom.placement: Upper body, skirt, neck closure loops

bom.specification: PROPOSED lightweight breathable woven lining 65–90 g/m²; no bulk at back opening
10 mm lightweight straight-grain tape; trial peel/strike-through
bom.placement: Neck, armholes, back opening, zip area

bom.specification: PROPOSED closed-end concealed coil No.3, 22 cm chain; no face topstitch over coil
Two 8 mm covered/tonal shank buttons; actual material TBD
Polyester Tex 18–24; Nm 65–75 sharp needle trial
Neutral development ID; fibre, care and origin text withheld pending verification
Fold with tissue at open back and gathers; fit actual folded sample

operations.method: Stabilize seam line I01; join shell to upper lining at neck and armholes, 8 mm SA / 301, 2.2–2.5 mm. Clip curves, grade allowances, understitch lining 2 mm where accessible. No visible neckline topstitch.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: PROPOSED 12 cm seam segment centred on waist at each side-front; source confirms gathers but not exact symmetry. Two temporary 301 gathering rows at 4 and 6 mm inside 10 mm SA; distribute fullness, join side seam at 2.5 mm stitch, remove exposed gathering threads.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Gather lower skirt evenly into low horizontal upper-body seam. Proposed lower-skirt/upper-join seam-line ratio 1.45; seam SA 10 mm / 301 at 2.5 mm. 504-neaten allowance together downward; no gathers trapped into zipper.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Narrow 10 + 10 mm double-turn hem / 301, 2.5 mm. Relax hanging dress 24 h before levelling; press without stretching diagonal print. Hem is not blind-stitched in this issue.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Stay I01 to back opening seam line before handling. Bag opening with F02, 8 mm SA / 301, 2.2 mm; clip/grade and understitch where possible. No unsupported elastic or boning. Confirm opening does not gape in movement.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Two B01 at rear bridge, proposed 12 mm vertical spacing. Make 2 mm finished self-fabric rouleau loops, each 12 mm finished projection, captured in 8 mm seam. Hand overcast shank attachment to reinforced shell/lining; no claimed machine hand-lockstitch.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Z01 22 cm chain starts 10 mm below open-back lower edge. CB SA 15 mm; stabilize 10 mm tape. Stitch tape close to unrolled coil with concealed-zip foot, 301 / 2.5 mm. Join CB below stop; lining turned and hand slipstitched to tape clear of coil.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Match stripe phase at CB and low skirt seam where repeat permits; no false continuous-stripe guarantee before strike-off. Upper lining lower edge free, neatened 504, swing-tacked at side seams; L01 in lining side.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

details: 8 mm clean-finished shell/lining seam with 10 mm stay tape; understitch where accessible, no exposed face stitch.
Lower skirt ratio 1.45 seam line; temporary 4/6 mm rows inside 10 mm seam. Side-front gather segment 12 cm proposed.
22 cm invisible chain below opening; two 8 mm buttons at neck bridge; self loops. Coil remains free of lining stitches.
pattern: Front upper section ×1 on fold (side gathering allowance proposed); upper backs ×2, lower skirt front/back ×1 each (CB opening continued for zip); upper lining front ×1/back ×2; two self-loop strips.
Stripe direction is printed diagonal on straight grain in this proposal; no extra diagonal panel seams. Confirm actual fabric repeat before cutting.
Do not invent princess seams or front darts; shape through side seams/gather allowance and back sections. Walk gathered/ungathered seam lengths separately.
Lower skirt seam-line circumference 108 × 1.45 = 156.6 cm base before seam allowances; hem expands to 160 cm full. This is a proposed pattern target, not marker evidence.
assembly: Test shell/lining shrinkage and print transfer; approve stripe strike-off.
Cut single layer for stripe matching; mark SNP, waist, gather segments and low seam.
Apply stay tape; prepare two neck loops and bridge reinforcement.
Join upper shell and lining using burrito/accessible shoulder sequence; clean neck, armholes and open back.
Gather side-front segments, close shell sides and lining sides independently.
Gather lower skirt into upper section; insert CB invisible zipper and close CB below.
Finish lining to zip tape, free lower lining edge and swing tacks.
Hang 24 h, level hem, narrow-turn stitch; attach buttons/labels, cool and inspect.
qc: Open-back edge lies flat with arms forward; no stretching or lining roll.
Two buttons/loops align without neck strain; zip opens sufficient dressing aperture.
Gathers evenly distributed at low seam; no stray gathering stitches visible.
Stripe alignment target assessed against actual repeat; no accidental slant seams.
Check bust/waist/hip ease and sitting mobility; lower skirt hangs level after relaxation.
risks: Material identity is untested; stable woven proposal may need side-gather/ease adjustment during toile fit.
Open-back stability and dressing aperture require sample fitting; no support/boning performance claimed.
Stripe repeat may materially increase fabric consumption and prevent perfect seam matching.
evidence: CONFIRMED in source: sleeveless round front neck, large rounded open back, two small rear-neck buttons, visible CB zip below opening, low horizontal skirt join and gathered lower skirt.
Diagonal stripes are surface pattern, not diagonal construction seams. Source shows localized side-front gathering; arms conceal exact endpoints.
Woven classification is PROPOSED from appearance and folder context; no fibre or fabric test confirms it.
assumptions: PROPOSED lightweight stable woven with engineered diagonal print, cut on straight grain. Do not infer bias cutting from stripe direction.
Propose lined upper section with neckline/open-back stabilization, no boning. Lower skirt unlined in this issue, subject to opacity trial.
Side-front gathering distributed over a proposed 12 cm waist-level seam segment; fullness ratio and precise location require toile validation.
consumption: ESTIMATE: shell 2.40–2.80 m at 150 cm usable width, EU 38, one-way diagonal print, 20% matching/cutting reserve; front/back upper sections + gathered lower skirt + neck opening facings. Upper lining 0.75–0.90 m at 140 cm. Stripe repeat unknown: estimate may increase after matching marker. No approved print/yield claim.
care: TBD: fibre identity, component compatibility, care testing, country of origin and destination-market legal review. Do not print generic care symbols.
labels: PROPOSED: neutral development ID + EU size; 35 × 12 mm soft ID label, ends turned 5 mm and secured with 301. No third-party logo or manufacturer claim. Placement: inside left upper lining side seam.
packaging: PROPOSED: fold only after cooling; use unprinted recyclable protective sleeve sized to the actual folded sample. Bag material, gauge and dimensions TBD after packing trial. One garment per sleeve; no invented approved bag size.
